blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Samuel was a boy who lived in the house of the LORD at Shiloh. His mother, Hannah, had given him to God's service when he was small, and he grew up helping the old priest Eli.

verses.text: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the child Samuel ministered unto the LORD before Eli. And the word of the LORD was precious in those days; there was no open vision.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Those were quiet years. People did not often hear from God. Eli was old now, and his eyes were failing.

verses.text: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And it came to pass at that time, when Eli was laid down in his place, and his eyes began to wax dim, that he could not see;

verses.text: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: The lamp in the temple was still burning low. Everything was still. And then a voice called the boy's name.

verses.text: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered, Here am I.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: That the LORD called Samuel: and he answered,

segments.speaker: samuel
segments.text: Here am I.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Samuel thought it was Eli. Who else would call him in the night? He got up and ran to the old man's side.

verses.text: And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou calledst me. And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

segments.text: And he ran unto Eli, and said,

segments.speaker: samuel
segments.text: Here am I; for thou calledst me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And he said, I called not; lie down again. And he went and lay down.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: So Samuel lay back down in the dark. Then it came again.

verses.text: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the LORD called yet again, Samuel. And Samuel arose and went to Eli, and said,

segments.speaker: samuel
segments.text: Here am I; for thou didst call me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And he answered, I called not, my son; lie down again.

verses.text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: Now Samuel did not yet know the LORD, neither was the word of the LORD yet revealed unto him.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Samuel knew how to trim the lamps and open the doors. He did not yet know the voice of the LORD for himself. A third time, the call came.

verses.text: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said, Here am I; for thou didst call me. And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the LORD called Samuel again the third time. And he arose and went to Eli, and said,

segments.speaker: samuel
segments.text: Here am I; for thou didst call me.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And Eli perceived that the LORD had called the child.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Now the old priest understood. This was not a dream, and it was not a mistake. Eli did not keep the moment for himself. He told the boy what to say.

verses.text: Therefore Eli said unto Samuel, Go, lie down: and it shall be, if he call thee, that thou shalt say, Speak, LORD; for thy servant heareth. So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: So Samuel went and lay down in his place.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: Samuel went back to his place and lay down. Maybe his heart was beating a little faster now, waiting in the dark.

verses.text: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered, Speak; for thy servant heareth.

segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: And the LORD came, and stood, and called as at other times, Samuel, Samuel. Then Samuel answered,

segments.speaker: samuel
segments.text: Speak; for thy servant heareth.

blocks.speaker: narrator
blocks.text: This time he did not run. He stayed where he was, and he listened. It was the first night of a long life of listening. The God who had seemed so quiet in those days knew a little boy's name, and called it more than once, until the boy understood who was speaking.
